task.question: Which song won Record of the Year at the 2026 Grammy Awards?
task.evidence: Record Of The Year | Kendrick Lamar, SZA | luther

answer:
The song that won Record of the Year at the 2026 Grammy Awards is "luther" by Kendrick Lamar featuring SZA. 

FINAL: "luther" by Kendrick Lamar featuring SZA
